closedThisRun.reason: THESIS INVALIDATED: Democratic sweep of Congress = dollar weakness thesis broken. EUR spiked from 1.1186 to 1.1267 (+0.7% in one session). Eurozone inflation at 4.0% (3-year high) + ECB hawkish rhetoric = EUR fundamental support. Dollar strength narrative from Fed hiking is now overwhelmed by political gridlock = fiscal constraint = less dollar demand. Cut the loser immediately. The obvious was obviously wrong — I was short EUR betting on dollar strength, but the election flipped the script.

macro.midterms: MAJOR DEVELOPMENT: Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in historic rebuke of Trump. 245+ House seats, Senate flipped. This is the KEY macro catalyst: (1) Trump fiscal agenda blocked → less spending → less Treasury issuance → dollar negative; (2) Gridlock = no new stimulus → economic slowdown risk → Fed may pivot sooner → dollar negative; (3) Regulatory scrutiny on AI/crypto/tech = risk-off for equities; (4) Gold wins as dollar debasement hedge in both hiking and cutting scenarios.

forwardView: 18 months out (May 2028): Democratic Congress = fiscal constraint, less Treasury issuance. Fed likely hikes once more in Dec 2026 then pauses. Economy slows under tight policy + fiscal drag. By mid-2027, Fed forced to pivot. Dollar weakens structurally. Gold to $5,000-6,000 (JPM target). EUR recovers toward 1.14-1.16. Risk assets eventually rally on Fed pivot but near-term pain from regulatory fears. The BIG call: gold is the cleanest expression of the dollar debasement thesis across all scenarios. When I have conviction, I go for the jugular — gold is the jugular trade.
